help_meta_description: Everything you need to know about buying a course, the free evaluation and signing in.
help_error_text: Something went wrong. Try again, or come back in a few minutes.
help_header_lead: From the free evaluation to the day your course ends. Can't find your answer? Give us a call.
help_road_label: The steps from the free evaluation to a finished course
help_road_bubble: After you send your request, {trainer} calls you.
help_road_stop_courses_line: The ones whose prerequisites are done.
help_road_stop_paying_line: You buy your course from the cart.
help_road_stop_training_line: {trainer} calls and you arrange it together.
help_ask_bubble: Or send a message, I'll deliver it!
help_ask_text: Talk to us directly, by phone or Telegram, whichever is easier for you.
help_group_evaluation_title: First we get to know each other
help_group_paying_title: I pick my course, then we arrange it
help_q_first_step_answer: First you sign up with your mobile number. Then you add your dogs one by one (there's an “Add a new dog” button under “My dogs”) and ask for the free evaluation for each dog separately. Until the evaluation is done, that dog's courses stay locked.
help_q_what_is_evaluation_a1: Before some courses start, we need to see where your dog is right now and which training suits it best.
help_q_what_is_evaluation_a2: The evaluation is a first check and test, in two parts. The first part is yours: in your request you pick one of your dogs and say from what date and at what times you're free, with photos and video if you like (they're optional). The second part is {trainer}'s: she calls you, you arrange a time, she meets your dog in person and records the result on the site.
help_q_what_is_evaluation_a3: That result shows which courses suit your dog. The evaluation itself is free. 🐾
help_q_evaluation_rejected_question: What if the evaluation doesn't happen or is declined?
help_q_evaluation_rejected_answer: {trainer} records the result on the site. If the dog isn't a fit or the meeting doesn't happen, the request is declined and the reason is sent to you by text message. Ask again whenever you like. While one request is waiting you can't make a new one, but you can withdraw that one.
help_q_which_courses_answer: A dog that has been evaluated can buy the courses whose prerequisites it has passed and whose age range fits its age. On each course's page you see whether each of your dogs can take it, and if not, why.
help_q_why_locked_question: Why is a course locked for my dog?
help_q_why_locked_r2: It hasn't finished the course before this one. A course that is only bought or sitting in the cart doesn't count
help_q_why_locked_r3: Its age doesn't fit the course's range
help_q_why_locked_r4: It's taking this very course right now
help_q_price_answer: Yes. Every course has a fixed price, written on its own page. The cart always shows today's price, and you pay the price you saw when you pressed “Pay”. The number of sessions depends on the dog and the kind of course.
help_q_no_price_question: How is the price of working and sport courses set?
help_q_no_price_a1: These courses do have prices, but the final cost depends on the start time, the level of training and your dog's situation. So before we give a firm amount, we look at the dog's situation and the training plan.
help_q_no_price_a2: They can't be bought on the site. To arrange one, call the center:
help_q_how_buying_works_s1: On the course page you pick one of your dogs and press “Add to cart”. You need to be signed in to pick a dog.
help_q_how_buying_works_s2: In the cart you see each item's price and whether it can be bought.
help_q_how_buying_works_s3: “Pay” takes you to the bank's payment gateway.
help_q_how_buying_works_s4: After a successful payment, {trainer} calls you and you arrange the training together.
help_q_how_buying_works_outro: You agree on the session times together on that call.
help_q_cart_question: Is my cart on my other phone too?
help_q_cart_answer: Yes. The cart is in your account, not just in one browser; sign in with the same number and you'll see it on any device. If you've just added something elsewhere and it isn't here, refresh the page once. A course you buy leaves the cart by itself.
help_q_several_question: Can I buy several courses together?
help_q_several_answer: Yes, even for several dogs, in one payment. You just can't put the same course in the cart twice for the same dog. If an item can't be bought, it gets a mark, it isn't paid for and it isn't counted in the cart's total.
help_q_payment_failed_question: The payment didn't go through. What happens?
help_q_payment_failed_answer: You come back to the cart and see the result at the top of the page. Your cart stays as it was and you can pay again.
help_q_after_paying_answer: A receipt arrives by text message and {trainer} is notified. She calls you and arranges the training. Your payments and the courses you've bought are under “Purchases” in your account.
help_q_cant_take_question: What if {trainer} can't take my dog?
help_q_cant_take_answer: If her schedule is full or it turns out the dog isn't right for this course, {trainer} cancels the course and returns your money outside the site. The refund is also shown on the “Purchases” page of your account.
help_q_lessons_intro: Depending on your situation and your dog, there are a few formats:
help_q_lessons_home_text: {trainer} comes to you and the training is just for you.
help_q_lessons_center_text: You and your dog come to the center and get training just for you.
help_q_lessons_group_text: Several dogs and their owners practice together. This format starts whenever a group class is held.
help_q_lessons_boarding_text: Your dog stays at a kennel for a while and the trainer does the training. This format needs prior arrangement.
help_q_lessons_where: Where do we practice? That depends on your dog's course! For example, some training happens inside the house and some practice has to happen outdoors. This is separate from whether the training is private or group: training can be fully private, yet part of its practice happens at home and part outside.
help_q_lessons_times: Each course's place is written on its page. {trainer} arranges the session times with you by phone.
help_q_logbook_answer: After each session, {trainer} writes on your dog's page what you worked on and how your dog progressed. Each dog also has a record number and a QR code; you see it on the dog's page and can print it. The record is private, and only you and {trainer} can see it.
help_q_boarding_answer: It's optional and priced separately from the course. Its price is written on the course page (or it says “call for the price”), but it can't be bought on the site. Boarding with training needs prior arrangement, because for now this service is provided with the help of a partner kennel. Call the center to arrange it.
help_q_course_done_answer: When the training is over, {trainer} marks the course “completed” on the site; you don't have to do anything. Then the course joins your dog's passed courses, the courses that had it as a prerequisite open up, and you get a text message. When the course's training is done and your dog passes the required steps, it also receives a course certificate. 🏅
help_q_sign_in_a1: With your mobile number and a code by text message. The first time you sign in, your account is created, and then we ask your name.
help_q_sign_in_a2: If you don't want to wait for a text every time, after signing in set a password under “Account settings”; from then on you can sign in with your number and password too. Forgot your password? Sign in with a text code and set a new one right there.
help_q_code_not_arrived_question: The text code didn't arrive. What do I do?
help_q_code_not_arrived_answer: The code has five digits and is valid for two minutes. After 60 seconds you can ask for a new code. After five wrong tries, that code stops working and you need to get a new one. If it still doesn't arrive, call the center.
